name: @papercusp/hive-app-seam
description: The ONE app⇄hive seam for papercusp hive-apps (Tier B template component): first-run hive bootstrap (bundled-blueprint local install with an idempotent fingerprint marker + ensure-hive over the operator HTTP API), the generic domain work-items transport over /api/harness/:slug/work-items (UP: enqueue kind:'task' items carrying a payload.domainKind envelope; DOWN: fetch resolved items' payload.out for an app-owned contract gate), and the best-effort poll ingest loop. Zero runtime deps; all side effects behind injected fetch/fs-free ports; the host binds app defaults (slugs, blueprint ids, contract parsers).
